verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only single-URL conversion via r.jina.ai and a search endpoint that fetches the top 5 results for a query, optionally filtered by site. Neither is a whole-site crawl that returns every page in one request. Site-filtered search is an adjacent feature, not crawling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can crawl an entire website and get content from all its pages with one request
